charts.title: Lookup wall time, warm, p50 of 20 (plan, plan + read, full scan, DuckDB)
charts.takeaway: Planning with the index and reading only the planned row groups beat a full scan in 0 of 42 lookups and DuckDB in 0 of 42; the plan alone (one bellwether process) took 88 ms at the median, of which 4 ms is starting any bellwether process.
